categories.main_business_segments: Postal Savings Bank of China (PSBC) operates primarily in retail banking, corporate banking, treasury and asset management, and inclusive finance. It serves personal customers, SMEs, and corporate clients with a focus on Sannong (agriculture, rural areas, and farmers) finance, technology finance, green finance, pension finance, and digital finance. The bank also manages majority-owned subsidiaries including PSBC Wealth Management, PSBC Consumer Finance, and YOU+ BANK.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: PSBC leverages advanced financial technologies including big data, AI, blockchain, cloud computing, and large language models such as its proprietary 'Youzhi' AI model. It has developed new-generation core banking systems for personal, corporate, and credit card businesses with high transaction processing capabilities. The bank emphasizes digital and intelligent transformation, including AI-powered customer service, risk control, and trading robots to enhance operational efficiency and risk management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The bank serves over 670 million personal customers, including middle-aged and elderly populations, and 1.8 million corporate clients, with a strong focus on rural residents, SMEs, and technology enterprises. It supports agriculture, rural revitalization, specialty industries, high-tech parks, industrial clusters, and government service customers. Key markets include retail banking, corporate banking, wealth management, and inclusive finance sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: PSBC operates extensively across China with approximately 40,000 outlets covering urban and rural areas. Its geographic segments include the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Bohai Rim, Central China, Western China, Northeastern China, and the Head Office in Beijing. It also maintains a principal place of business in Hong Kong but is not authorized to conduct banking business there.
categories.supply_chain_position: PSBC operates primarily as a downstream financial services provider, offering deposit-taking, lending, wealth management, and payment services. It acts as a main force in rural revitalization and inclusive finance, providing financial support to end customers such as individuals, SMEs, and enterprises, rather than upstream production or manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The bank’s strategic priorities focus on five financial sector priorities: technology finance, green finance, inclusive finance, pension finance, and digital finance. It invests heavily in fintech innovation, including AI, big data, and blockchain, to enhance risk management, customer service, and operational efficiency. PSBC also emphasizes digital transformation, development of new core systems, and building a digital ecosystem-based bank to support high-quality development and national strategies.
categories.revenue_model: PSBC generates revenue mainly through net interest income from loans and deposits, fee and commission income from banking services such as wealth management, investment banking, custody, and payment services, as well as trading gains from financial market operations. It also earns income from its subsidiaries engaged in wealth management and consumer finance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: PSBC is positioned as one of China’s leading large-scale retail banks and ranks as the fifth major state-owned bank by asset scale. It holds a strong market presence in rural and inclusive finance, technology finance, and pension finance. Its competitors include other major state-owned banks and commercial banks in China. PSBC differentiates itself through its extensive outlet network, focus on underserved markets, and integration of technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of end-2024, PSBC reported total assets of RMB17.08 trillion, an 8.64% increase year-on-year, with total loans of RMB8.91 trillion and customer deposits of RMB15.29 trillion. Operating income was RMB349.13 billion, up 1.81%, and net profit attributable to equity holders was RMB86.48 billion, stable year-on-year. The bank has shown steady growth in assets, loans, deposits, and profitability, maintaining strong capital adequacy and asset quality.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: PSBC emphasizes customer-centric, accessible, and inclusive financial services with a unique model combining directly-operated and agency outlets. It offers differentiated products tailored to rural customers, SMEs, technology enterprises, and pensioners. The bank leverages advanced fintech to provide convenient, efficient, and intelligent services, including proactive credit extension, scenario-based financing, and a comprehensive pension finance system. Its extensive network and integration with China Post Group resources provide competitive advantages in serving underserved markets.
